records.name: Authentication
records.description: Console and API sign-in, session issuance, SAML/OIDC single sign-on, and API token exchange.

records.name: Analytics Dashboard
records.description: Interactive dashboards, saved reports, and scheduled exports in the Northstar console.

records.name: Connector API
records.description: Scheduled and on-demand syncs that pull customer warehouse data into Northstar.

records.name: Public API
records.description: Customer-facing REST API and gateway: request routing, rate limiting, and webhook delivery to customer endpoints.

records.name: Billing
records.description: Subscriptions, invoicing, and reconciliation of payment-provider webhooks against account state.

records.name: Notifications
records.description: Transactional email and in-product alerts: invitations, password resets, and delivery to the upstream mail provider.

records.name: Search
records.description: Full-text indexing and query for documents, reports, and workspace objects.

records.name: File Processing
records.description: Upload intake, format conversion, scanning, and the worker pipeline that makes uploaded files available.
